hook: Your own private ChatGPT in fifteen minutes

beats.say: A new beginner's guide shows how to run a private chatbot at home with Unsloth Desktop, no terminal or Python needed.
The author runs Qwen 3.8 27B at 4-bit on an RTX 5090 with 32 gigabytes of video memory, leaving room for a 128K context.
Smaller cards still work: eight to twelve gigabytes handles nine to twelve billion parameter models. Setup takes about ten to fifteen minutes, plus downloads.
